TO MY FAV PERSON

October feels a little more special because I get to spend it loving you. I hope this month brings us more beautiful moments, more memories and more reasons to smile together. No matter how many months and years pass, I'll always choose you, and I'll always be grateful that you're the person I get to share my life with. Here's to another month of us, and to all the beautiful months waiting for us.
